$comment: The site's contact and visitor-count options (documentation/desktop/spec.md §9.5, plan stage 11; the research in documentation/desktop/site-services.md). Edit mode's Settings cards, the app's `atiya services` command and the site's skill read this file; tests/unit/servicesCatalogue.test.ts holds it to the content contract (src/site/content/schema.ts). Every value an option asks for is public by design: never a secret. An option's `csp` names the hosts the site's Content Security Policy must allow for it, by directive (src/site/services/csp.ts): `{origin}` is the origin of the link a person pasted, `{code}` GoatCounter's code name, `{host}` Umami's host.

contact.name: Email me
contact.gives: A button that opens the visitor's email app, addressed to you.
contact.asks: Nothing but the address it opens.

steps.text: Write the address you want visitors to use (never GitHub's no-reply one).

contact.name: Web3Forms
contact.gives: Your site's own Contact form, emailed to you on each message, with spam protection. No file uploads.
contact.asks: One key, sent to your inbox.

steps.text: Enter your email on Web3Forms' page.
Open the email Web3Forms sends and copy the access key.
Paste the key here, then send yourself a test message from the Contact page.

contact.name: Tally
contact.gives: Your own form with any fields, unlimited answers free, and an email for each one.
contact.asks: A free account, a form you build, and its link.

steps.text: Sign up at Tally and build your form.
Turn on email notifications in the form's settings.
Publish it and copy its link.
Paste the link here.

contact.name: Google Forms
contact.gives: A form most people know how to build, with the answers in a sheet.
contact.asks: A Google account, a form you build, and its link.

steps.text: Build the form in Google Forms.
In Responses, turn on Get email notifications for new responses.
Choose Send, then the link, and copy the full link (not the short one).
Paste the link here.

contact.name: Jotform
contact.gives: Long forms with conditions, file uploads and payments, and an email for each answer.
contact.asks: A free account and a form, built by you or by your agent through Jotform's API.

steps.text: Sign up at Jotform.
Build the form, or give your agent an API key from Settings to build it.
Paste the form's link here.

contact.name: Cal.com
contact.gives: Book a call: your free times, the visitor picks one, and you both get an email.
contact.asks: A free account, your calendar connected, and an event type.

steps.text: Sign up at Cal.com and connect your calendar.
Make an event type and copy its link.
Paste the link here.

counts.name: GoatCounter
counts.gives: Visits, pages, where visitors came from and their countries. No cookies, so no banner.
counts.asks: A free account and its code name.

steps.text: Sign up at GoatCounter (a code name and your email).
Type the code name here.

counts.name: Umami Cloud
counts.gives: Visits and pages like GoatCounter, plus events and goals, in a nicer dashboard. No cookies.
counts.asks: A free account, your site added, and its website ID.

steps.text: Sign up at Umami Cloud.
Add your site and copy its website ID.
Paste the ID here.

counts.name: Google Analytics
counts.gives: Audiences, sources and links to Search Console. It uses a cookie, so visitors are asked first.
counts.asks: A Google account, a property and a web stream.

steps.text: Sign up at Google Analytics.
Make a property and a web stream for your site's address.
Paste the measurement ID (G-…) here.

addons.name: Microsoft Clarity
addons.gives: Heatmaps and recordings of visits, free. It uses cookies, so visitors are asked first.
addons.asks: A Microsoft account, your site added, and its project ID.

steps.text: Sign up at Clarity with a Microsoft account.
Add your site and copy its project ID (Settings, Overview).
Paste the ID here.

shapes.embed: An https link to a form on one of the allowed services.
shapes.goatcounter: 2 to 50 lowercase letters, digits or dashes.
shapes.ga4: G- and then letters and digits.
